info.description: Local service access, browser authorization, client connection/Session and transaction lifecycle, browser execution coordination, wallet handoff and connection consent.
info.title: Wallet Bridge Local API

post.description: Requires Origin http://127.0.0.1:18765, including for native HTTP callers. The ticket is consumed once; after a failed or lost exchange request a new link. Cookie is host-only, HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, Path=/api/v1, with fixed expiration. The HTTP loopback cookie does not use Secure. JSON never returns the cookie secret. Request body is limited to 1024 bytes; query parameters are rejected.
post.summary: Exchange a one-time ticket for browser authorization

parameters.description: One-use ticket from the link fragment
parameters.name: request

get.description: Requires a valid management cookie. Same-origin GET may omit Origin. Any supplied Origin must match the local service. Bearer alone cannot authorize this endpoint. Accepts no body or query parameters. Applies the original request deadline but never renews a Session, takes execution ownership, or invokes a wallet.
get.summary: Read a connection for browser review

parameters.description: Must match the local service if supplied
parameters.name: Origin

get.description: Requires a valid management cookie. Same-origin GET may omit Origin. Any supplied Origin must match the local service. Accepts no body or query parameters. No execution returns 404 execution_not_found. Reads neither normalize stale phases nor acquire ownership or renew heartbeat/Session lifetime; subsequent mutations check liveness transactionally. No browser grant ID or secret is returned.

parameters.description: Must match the local service if supplied
parameters.name: Origin

post.description: Newly committed handoff grants invoke once. Retry with the same callId and previousCallId after a lost response. Only invoke=true authorizes this page to open the wallet. JSON body limit: 1024 bytes. No query parameters.

Requires management cookie and exact local Origin; the cookie supplies the browser subject, never the JSON body. Body contains only a fresh execution id, limited to 1024 bytes; query parameters are rejected. Retry with the same id; a matching retry does not renew heartbeat. Another owner/phase or occupied global wallet slot returns 409. Query the original request/execution instead of automatically generating a replacement id. Claiming never invokes a wallet or creates a Session.
Submit after explicit consent with the actual wallet, account and network. A matching retry returns the committed connection and Session ID. JSON body limit: 8192 bytes. No query parameters.
post.summary: Confirm a connection with a wallet binding

parameters.description: Confirm a connection with a wallet binding
parameters.name: request

post.description: Requires management cookie and exact local Origin. Body contains only the current execution id, limited to 1024 bytes; no query parameters. Does not extend the connection deadline or Session lifetime. Stale, interrupted, replaced or terminal executions cannot be revived by a heartbeat; query after a 409.

Requires management cookie and exact local Origin. Body contains only the current execution id, limited to 1024 bytes; no query parameters. Repeating interruption is idempotent. An unfinished wallet handoff remains interrupted_calling and occupies the slot; interruption cannot dismiss its popup or cancel the connection.

Requires management cookie and exact local Origin. After the user ends the previous page/wallet operation, submit a fresh execution id and the expected previousId; retry with both unchanged. Body is limited to 1024 bytes; no query parameters. An active request gets a new execution and must recheck wallet/account/network. A terminal request only clears outstanding waiting and returns the original execution as finished; the new id is not installed and no Session is created. Old results cannot complete the new execution. Recovery does not invoke a wallet.

parameters.description: Fresh ID and expected previous execution ID
parameters.name: request

post.description: Reject using the current ready execution. A matching replay returns the committed rejection. JSON body limit: 1024 bytes. No query parameters.
Return the same callId after the wallet promise settles. A return never grants consent or establishes a Session. JSON body limit: 1024 bytes. No query parameters.
post.summary: Record that the wallet call ended

parameters.description: Record that the wallet call ended
parameters.name: request

post.description: Requires the browser cookie and exact local Origin, even when a Bearer token is also present. Revokes the persistent grant before expiring its cookie. Accepts no body or an empty JSON object, limited to 1024 bytes; query parameters are rejected.

Set-Cookie.description: Expires the current browser management cookie

get.description: Returns unexpired requests oldest first, then by kind and ID for ties. Reading the list does not claim the wallet or renew any deadline. Requires the management cookie. Accepts no query parameters or body.
get.summary: List pending connection and transaction approvals

parameters.description: Must match the local service if supplied
parameters.name: Origin

get.description: Returns the frozen transaction, its latest recorded state and the wallet selected for its Session. The original approval deadline applies. Reading does not claim the wallet or renew the Session or execution. Requires the management cookie. Accepts no query parameters or request body.
get.summary: Read a transaction for browser review

parameters.description: Must match the local service if supplied
parameters.name: Origin

post.description: Any authorized management page may confirm that the original popup has been handled. Releases its slot and preserves the original transaction for a late wallet report. Accepts an empty body or {}.

get.description: Reports the recorded phase without claiming or renewing the execution. An interrupted preparation includes the ID needed for manual recovery. A page opening the transaction for the first time sees unclaimed.

post.description: Use a page-generated execution id. Claim, heartbeat and interrupt require only action and id. Recover takes a new id and the observed recoverFromId as previousId. Begin preparation takes a fresh callId and the preceding call ID as previousId, omitted for the first call. Return preparation uses the original callId. Reuse IDs on retry. Invoke a wallet preparation only on invoke=true. After a send handoff only heartbeat and interrupt are available here.
post.summary: Coordinate a review or a wallet preparation call

post.description: Also accepts a queued request. Returns the effective state if cancellation, expiry or wallet handoff already took effect. Accepts an empty body or {}.
post.summary: Reject a pending transaction from its review page

post.description: Supply exactly one of txHash or errorCode. Use code 0 when the provider gives no code. A valid replacement browser authorization may submit the original identifiers after the initial grant ends. A late hash can resolve an uncertain result.
post.summary: Report the result of the original wallet send

parameters.description: Original execution and send call IDs with the wallet result
parameters.name: request

post.description: After user confirmation, submit the observed wallet binding and a fresh send call ID. Only invoke=true with the returned frozen payload permits the page to call the wallet. Retry transport failures with the original IDs.
post.summary: Obtain a one-time transaction send permit

parameters.description: Current execution, call and observed binding
parameters.name: request

post.description: Requires the service Bearer, never a browser cookie. Generate a 32-character lowercase hexadecimal ID once and reuse it for transport retries. Matching content returns the original state and deadline; changed content returns 409. Both creation and replay return 200, which does not imply user consent. chainId must be a decimal or 0x hexadecimal string, never a JSON number. Body limit is 8192 bytes. Query parameters and unknown fields are rejected. No browser link or wallet invocation is provided by this endpoint.
post.summary: Create or retry a connection request

get.description: Requires the service Bearer. No body or query parameters. Expired pending requests become expired; reads never renew the resulting Session. On success, use sessionId to explicitly access the fixed wallet/account/network through GET /sessions/{id}. A terminal request remains queryable after Session closure.

post.description: Requires the service Bearer. Accepts no body or an empty JSON object, limited to 1024 bytes; no query parameters. Repeated cancellation preserves the original result. A different terminal outcome, including expiry, returns 409; query the original ID to reconcile. This does not close an existing Session or dismiss a wallet popup.

get.description: Requires the local service token; browser cookies cannot list grants. Includes active, expired and revoked records, newest first. The cursor is the last grant ID from the preceding page. Secrets and their digests are never returned.

parameters.description: Last grant ID of the preceding page
parameters.name: after

post.description: Requires the local service token. The URL contains a two-minute, one-use secret in its fragment. Do not log or expose it in ordinary status output. Accepts no body or an empty JSON object.

Requires the local service token. Choose a single grant id or all=true, exclusively. Repeating revocation of an existing record succeeds without changing its first revocation time. Revoke-all also invalidates all outstanding authorization links. Request body is limited to 1024 bytes; query parameters are rejected.
Requires the local service token. Accepts no body or an empty JSON object, limited to 1024 bytes. HTTP 202 means shutdown was requested, not that the process has exited.

get.description: A 64-character lowercase hexadecimal challenge produces an HMAC-SHA256 proof binding the response metadata. No credentials or data directory are returned.

Requires the service Bearer. No body or query parameters. Only an active Session renews its five-minute idle time. Expired or explicitly closed records return state=closed with their original fixed binding and closure time; reading never revives them. GET /connections/{id} does not renew this idle time.
get.summary: Access a Session or its closed history

post.description: Requires the service Bearer. Accepts no body or an empty JSON object, limited to 1024 bytes; no query parameters. Closure is idempotent and does not delete history. A Session cannot be created or rebound by this endpoint.

get.description: With an active browser cookie, activeWalletRequest identifies the connection or transaction occupying the wallet. For connections, walletOperation also supplies the API 1.6 representation. Both fields are omitted for an idle wallet and for service Bearer callers. Reading status does not renew or acquire an execution.

post.description: Reuse the request ID for retries. Matching normalized content returns the original record and deadline. A changed request with that ID returns 409. Amounts and fees are strings in smallest units, in decimal or 0x hexadecimal. Omitted value and data default to zero and empty bytes. Omit fees for wallet estimation. The JSON body limit is 1 MiB.
post.summary: Create or retry a transaction request

parameters.description: Caller metadata and transaction for a fixed Session
parameters.name: request

get.description: Reads the original request without renewing its deadline or Session. A late wallet reply can update an uncertain result. A transaction hash identifies a submitted transaction. The client can use the chain ID and hash to query a receipt.
get.summary: Read the transaction and its latest result

post.description: Accepts an empty body or an empty JSON object. Returns the effective state, including expiry or an earlier wallet handoff. Check state before treating the transaction as canceled.

message.example: A valid Bearer token is required

intent.description: Optional caller-supplied description, displayed separately from the transaction fields.

BrowserCookie.description: Swagger 2.0 represents this cookie as a header. Use wallet_bridge_browser=<secret>. Browser connection mutations require the exact local Origin. Reads may omit it. Browser clients receive the cookie through Set-Cookie, never through JSON.
BrowserCookie.name: Cookie

ServiceBearer.description: Bearer token from the current user's client.key, shared by trusted local clients for service access and management.
ServiceBearer.name: Authorization
